newsitem.title: USA: Brazil coffee areas to turn cool, but no frost - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee areas to turn cool, but no frost - WSC.

text.p: Colder air is expected to develop over Argentina today and move into Brazil's coffee belt on Friday and Saturday, but no damaging cold is expected, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Thursday.

Mostly fair weather is expected in Brazil's coffee belt Thursday, with some scattered showers in the south. Fair skies were observed this morning and temperatures were near normal with lows in the 50s to low 60s F (low to middle teens C).
WSC expects a chance of scattered showers and thunderstorms to develop Thursday, with clearing skies in the evening.

Fair to partly cloudy skies are expected for Friday and increasing clouds on Saturday with the chance of a few showers. Cooler weather is in store for the weekend, with temperatures falling into the 40s to low 50s F (5-12 C).
However, no damaging cold is indicated, WSC said. ((New York Commodity Desk, 212 859-1640))
